ext_table_benchmark: Extension: posts, fact-check pools and subsets per language (Zawgyi converted: 81 posts, 0 fact-checks)
ext_table_retrieval: Extension: retrieval nDCG@10 on the test posts
ext_table_retrieval_low_overlap: Extension: nDCG@10 on the low-overlap test subset
ext_table_retrieval_novel: Extension: nDCG@10 on the novel test subset (secondary)
ext_table_retrieval_dev: Extension: dev nDCG@10 (chooses the best single retriever for E1)
ext_pool_recall50: Extension: hybrid top-50 candidate lists on the test posts, Hit@50 and Recall@50
ext_leak_test: Extension: leak test (decisions with unpaid computation replaced by noise)
ext_fold_sources: Extension: source languages used to train the allocator for each target
ext_table_rerank_BGE-reranker-v2-m3: Extension: re-ranking nDCG@10 at B = 0.50, leave-one-language-out (BGE-reranker-v2-m3, mean of 5 seeds)
ext_table_rerank_mMiniLM-L12: Extension: re-ranking nDCG@10 at B = 0.50, leave-one-language-out (mMiniLM-L12, mean of 5 seeds)
ext_secondary_novel: Extension, secondary: the E1–E4 comparisons on the novel test subset
ext_table_hypotheses: Extension: pre-registered hypotheses E1–E4 (nDCG@10 effects as fractions)
